# Replace <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Replace:String string:String, from:String, to:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to change. |
| `from` | In | String | required | What to look for. |
| `to` | In | String | required | What to put in its place. May be empty to remove it. |

**Returns:** The changed text.

## Description

Replaces every occurrence of a piece of text with another. What was put in is not searched again, so replacing `a` with `aa` does not loop.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Replace$("a-b-c", "-", "+")
Print Replace$("a-b-c", "-", "")
```

```text
a+b+c
abc
```
